prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. Herds of sheep, goats, oxen and camels spread out across a wide green valley and birds rise over it, a family in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, watching from the hillside in the foreground. Bright day. Abundant. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
